subject: SuperMart: implementation playbook & sprint milestones
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Johnson <s.johnson@supermart.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@supermart.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: SuperMart: implementation playbook & sprint milestones

Hi Sara/Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Per our discussion I’ve attached a working draft of the implementation playbook (SuperMart_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a high-level SOW draft for your procurement team. The goal here is to document milestones, owners, and target dates so we can align internal teams and confirm any constraints on your side.

TL;DR proposed timeline (subject to your procurement lead):
- Week 0 (Jul 6): Project kickoff — legal + network checks + kickoff workshop (owner: Redwood CSM)
- Week 1–2 (Jul 7–20): Integration sprint 1 — API keys, VPC peering (owner: Redwood SE)
- Week 3 (Jul 21–27): Streaming / load testing + Quantization validation (owner: Redwood SE + infra)
- Week 4 (Jul 28–Aug 3): Training for Product & Ops + deployment to dedicated pool (owner: CSM + Ops)
- Week 6 (Aug 11): Go-live readiness review; production roll (owner: AE + CSM)

Ask: can you confirm procurement timeline and whether your security team needs an on-prem package or VPC? I’ve cc’d Laura (CSM) and Marcus (SE) to begin scheduling technical touchpoints.

Attachments: SuperMart_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), SOW-draft-SuperMart.pdf (SOW)

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
From: Sara Johnson <s.johnson@supermart.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: SuperMart: implementation playbook & sprint milestones

Priyom — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear plan. A few items from procurement/security side that will affect the timeline:

- Our procurement expects to complete contract review by Jul 10 if we receive the final SOW this week; we have a 7–10 business day review SLA.
- Security needs the SOC2 artefacts + network diagram before we can approve VPC peering; can Laura share the SOC2 summary and a short network checklist?
- We will likely require a short pilot (2-week pilot window) to validate integrations before full production rollout — prefer pilot window Jul 21–Aug 4.

I’ve attached our procurement schedule (procurement_schedule.xlsx) showing internal review dates and the names of our procurement and legal points of contact.

If procurement finishes on Jul 10 we should be able to start the integration sprint Jul 13; if not, we’ll need to slide the kickoff a week.

I’ll loop in our security lead later today if you want a direct sync.

—Sara
Sara Johnson
VP, Digital Ops | SuperMart Retail
(s.johnson@supermart.com)

Thanks @Sara — Laura here (CSM) — happy to take point on the kickoff and SOC2/materials. I’ll prepare a condensed security packet and a Network Readiness Checklist by EOD Jul 2.

Proposed immediate actions (for confirmation):
1) Kickoff workshop — Jul 13 (virtual, 90 minutes) — agenda: objectives, network checklist, SSO/API keys, data flows, success metrics.
2) Technical onboarding sessions — Jul 14 (SE deep-dive) and Jul 16 (ops runbook + alerting).
3) Pilot window — Jul 21–Aug 4 (two weeks) — run production-like traffic, validate latency and cost buckets.
4) Final readiness review — Aug 11; go/no-go for production traffic Aug 15.

Owners:
- Redwood CSM (Laura): kickoff + playbook updates + success metrics
- Redwood SE (Marcus): API integration, KV caching, latency tests
- Redwood AE (Priyom): procurement + contract coordination
- SuperMart (Sara/Carlos): procurement signoff + security approvals

I’ll attach the SOC2 summary and network checklist to this thread when ready. If the procurement schedule holds Jul 10 we can keep the Jul 13 kickoff; otherwise we aim for Jul 20.

Cheers —
Laura Bennett

Subject: Re: SuperMart: implementation playbook & sprint milestones

Quick technical clarifications from the SE side:

- Integration scope: we’ll need API key exchange + optional VPC peering. If SuperMart prefers VPC peering, allow 3 business days for network IP whitelisting and routing updates on both sides.
- Pilot checks: we’ll focus on (a) prefix/KV cache warm-up, (b) streaming latency at 512-token median, (c) cost per 1k tokens with proposed batching. Need a sample traffic CSV (100–200 requests) to script the pilot.
- Dependencies: access to a staging S3 bucket (read-only) and a short-term API key with the same rate limits as production.

Proposed SE timeline (aligned to playbook):
- Jul 13: SE technical kickoff + env provisioning
- Jul 14–20: API integration + peering config (if applicable)
- Jul 21–Aug 4: Pilot execution + automated load tests
- Aug 5–7: Triage and tuning; produce Pilot Report

Action: Sara/Carlos — can you share a 100-request sample (CSV) and confirm whether you can provision staging S3 access by Jul 10?

—Marcus
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Sara/Carlos — great alignment here, thanks everyone for quick responses. To capture next steps I’ve updated the MAP in the attached XLSX and locked in the following targets assuming procurement clears Jul 10:

Confirmed schedule (final):
- Jul 13, 09:00–10:30 PT: Project kickoff (virtual) — invite to follow (owner: Laura)
- Jul 14, 11:00–12:30 PT: SE technical onboarding + staging provisioning (owner: Marcus)
- Jul 21–Aug 4: Pilot window (owner: SuperMart + Redwood SE) — goal: validate latency & functional flows
- Aug 5–7: Pilot remediation and tuning (owner: Redwood SE)
- Aug 11: Readiness review & go/no-go decision (owner: Priyom + Laura)

Deliverables we’ll circulate before kickoff:
- Final SOW (SOW-draft-SuperMart.pdf) — Priyom/Aditya to send to procurement by EOD Jul 1
- SOC2 summary + Network Readiness Checklist — Laura to attach by Jul 2
- Pilot sample CSV + staging access — SuperMart to provide by Jul 10

If this looks good I’ll send calendar invites and a single doc link (read-only) for the MAP. Appreciate the quick coordination — look forward to getting started.

Best —
